results.title: Double dissolution elections: How they work and why Labor is considering calling one | SBS News
excerpts: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has refused to rule out calling a double dissolution election over Labor's stalled housing scheme... "We'll wait and see," Albanese said after being asked about the possibility of a double dissolution. "I'll tell you one way to avoid a (double dissolution) is for the Coalition and the Greens to vote for legislation that they support."

excerpts: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has put pressure on parliament to pass two signature housing reforms, a separate environment law overhaul and its Future Made in Australia bill – all of which have been met with fierce resistance from the Coalition and Greens.
